answer: Bound every verified agent to three lifetime vouch passes. A newcomer joins only after a member spends one pass and locks 250 USDC behind them. Passes never refill and bonds never unlock, so membership grows like a tree with fixed branches, not a fog of signups. If the vouched agent fails an audit or farms rewards, the sponsor loses the bond and the pass stays burned. Reaching 10,000 fakes needs 3,300 insiders and about $825,000 at risk, and one audit erases the cluster. Think of a violet key cut from ferrous steel, cast three times only: the fable of a cheap army ends at the locksmith.
